accounts.title: Accounts

summary.fullnessFull: Per-month data status: empty, transactions present, balance-chain break, or uncategorized correcting entries.

summary.expenseCountFull: Share of expense transactions (excluding transfers between own accounts) that have at least one category. Counted by transaction count — answers: “how many expense txns have I tagged?”

summary.expenseAmountFull: Share of expenses by amount: σ category coverage ÷ total expenses for the month (excluding transfers between own accounts). Partial coverage counts proportionally.

accounts.legendTitle: How to read the monthly activity
accounts.legendIntro: Each cell is one month. The fill colour reflects how complete the data is for that month; the border encodes special states.

legendItems.preAccount: Month before the account existed — the cell is empty.
legendItems.complete: Transactions exist for this month — data is present.
legendItems.anchored: Later transactions exist, so the chain continues past this month. The current month never gets this border.
legendItems.error: A transaction's balance in this month doesn't match the previous one — the chain is broken.
legendItems.dashed: Uncategorized correcting entries are present in this month and should be reviewed.

Each row is matched to an existing transaction by date, amounts and balance, and its counterparty, bank description and comment are overwritten from the row, including blanks (an empty cell clears the value). telegram.title: Import from Telegram · {account}
telegram.intro: Choose the channel's HTML export: Export Chat in Telegram, without media. You can check and correct every message before the import. Imported messages will not come back; ignored ones wait on the Ignore tab.
telegram.notation: Rules: each line of a message is read on its own. A number at the start of a line is the amount of an expense, with a plus of income: “145 stationery”, “+1300 from a neighbour”. A single number elsewhere in the line reads the same way. Several numbers in a line, or an amount not in plain digits (1.000, 8k), go to review; messages without numbers are ignored, messages with attachments are not counted.
telegram.timezone: Time zone of the times in the file
telegram.timezoneHint: The export has no time zone: times are as Telegram showed them when exporting. The value chosen last time is suggested.

telegram.noMessages: No messages with text found in the file. The channel's HTML export is needed.
telegram.badDates: Could not read the date of messages: {count}. Example: “{sample}”. The import only knows this format so far: 16 November 2024, 12:34:56.
telegram.statsSkipped: Ignored earlier, on the Ignore tab: {count}

telegram.rollbackConfirm: Delete the entries of this import ({count}), including any edits made to them?

agent.title: Category agent
agent.hint: Suggests one category per transaction via “Actions ▾ → Suggest categories”. It learns from your examples: per category, the transactions you starred, topped up with recent categorised ones when there are fewer than the set number.
agent.cloudWarning: This is a cloud provider: transaction descriptions, your notes, slip notes and your “Life context → Context” text go to it. The balance is never sent.
agent.instructionsHint: In your own words — how you categorise. The app adds the category list, the examples and the answer format itself.
agent.minConfidence: Suggest only with confidence of at least (0–10)
agent.minConfidenceHint: The agent suggests a category only for obvious cases. Where it is not sure (confidence below the threshold, or no category named), the Suggestion column shows an “agent not sure” mark with the reason. Its guess is kept: lower the threshold and the guesses that reach it become suggestions at once, without asking the model again. It is not asked again until the examples or the transaction's notes change; “Ask again” in the run dialog asks those too.
agent.autoExamples: When fewer are starred, top up to this number with recent categorised transactions (all starred ones always go in)
agent.usageEmpty: The agent has not been called yet.

description.hint: Describe your life now in your own words: where you live, what you do, who is in the family and their names, hobbies, what names and abbreviations in your notes mean. The category agent gets this text with every transaction, so it knows who is who in notes like “Alex tennis”. If the agent's connection is a cloud one, the text goes to that provider.

For example:
We live by the sea; I work remotely.
Family: partner Sam; kids Alex (12) and Robin (8).
Alex goes to tennis, Robin plays chess.
MARIA COSTA is Alex's tutor.

guide.title: Guide: what to do once a month
guide.when: When: in the first 5–7 days of the month. We put the previous month in order: by then banks give out its full statements.
guide.goal: Goal: a report that explains as much spending as possible. In the end the report has a minimum in the Uncategorized row and in the Cash remaining metric.
guide.during: Write cash spending down in the Telegram channel, one expense per line: “145 stationery”. Do not write ATM withdrawals there: they come from the statement at the step Link transfers and withdrawals. Use a plus only for what the statement does not have: cash received directly (“+1300 from a neighbour”) and currency exchange. This is rare, so say where the money came from. Write notes without numbers, or ignore them at import. Just keep slips and receipts.
guide.stepsTitle: Steps at the start of the month

statements.title: Load bank statements
statements.body: Download last month's statements from your banks. On Accounts, press Import in the row of each bank account and load the file.
statements.done: last month is filled in the activity strip of every account, with no red marks of balance discrepancies.

telegram.title: Load cash from Telegram
telegram.body: In Telegram, open the channel and choose Export Chat, no media needed. On Accounts, press Entries in the row of the cash account, then Import from Telegram…. Go through the tabs: move bank operations to Ignore. There is usually little income, so check each one: is it clear where the money came from? Correct currency exchange by hand.
telegram.done: the Check tab is empty. What you did not finish is saved and opens with Sort out, no file needed.

regular.title: Enter regular payments
regular.body: In the same Entries of the cash account, press Regular payments… and carry the 🔄 entries over to last month. This step is for recurring expenses that are not in the channel.
regular.done: last month's regular entries are on the account and do not repeat entries from the channel.

documents.title: Load slips and receipts
documents.body: On Documents, upload the files or a ZIP of last month and wait for recognition. Then on Transactions select the month's transactions and choose Actions → Match documents. Notes from slips help the agent with categories.
documents.done: slips are linked to transactions, and you have looked through the unlinked ones.

context.title: Mark the life context
context.body: On Life context, add what happened last month: trips, guests, illness. The agent takes this into account when it suggests categories, so this step comes before them.
context.done: the month's important events are on the list.

links.title: Link transfers and withdrawals
links.body: On Transactions, set the period to last month and select all rows. From Actions, run Find transfers between accounts and Find cash withdrawals, then decide on the suggestions in the Suggestion column. An accepted cash withdrawal creates the income on the cash account and links it to the debit by itself. Linked transfers between your own accounts count as neither income nor expense.
links.warning: A withdrawal must reach the cash account once. A cash withdrawal suggestion creates a new income and does not check whether one is already there, which is why withdrawals are not written in the channel. If one was, delete one of the two entries: the line from Telegram or the income from the suggestion.
links.done: every withdrawal and transfer has its link, and each withdrawal appears once on the cash account.

categories.title: Assign categories
categories.body: Select the month's transactions and choose Actions → Suggest categories. Look through the suggestions and take them with Accept suggestions…. Filter → Without a category finds the rest: do it by hand with Actions → Assign category, or a click on the cell. Mark good examples with ✨, so the agent makes fewer mistakes next time.
categories.done: hardly any grey Uncategorized bars remain among the month's transactions.

report.title: Check the report
report.body: Open the report for last month and look at the Uncategorized row and the Cash remaining metric. A large cash remainder means there was a withdrawal with no expenses entered against it: go back to the Telegram step. On Accounts, the Summary menu's % cat. expense (sum) metric shows the share of explained spending for each account.
report.done: you are fine with Uncategorized and Cash remaining, and can name the unexplained amounts.

waterfall.chartLabel: Column chart from the opening to the closing balance of the period
waterfall.adjustmentsHint: The account balance moved by more than its operations add up to: correcting rows or missing statements.
waterfall.fxHint: Operations are converted at the last rate known on their day, balances at the start and end of the period. The rate difference of exchanges between your own accounts lands here too.
waterfall.tooltipClick: Click to see what it consists of
waterfall.panelHint: Click categories: they appear on the chart in this order, a nested one always before its group. Everything else goes to “Other”.
waterfall.moveDown: Down the list: column to the right
waterfall.moveUp: Up the list: column to the left
waterfall.nestedFirst: A nested category always comes before its group
waterfall.ratesStale: Last downloaded rate: {rates}. Anything later is converted at it. Rates can be updated in the currency settings.
waterfall.systemHint: This is neither income nor an expense. It is how the balances differ from the sum of operations: exchange rate moves and balance changes with no operation behind them.
waterfall.rateModeFixed: My own, one for the period
waterfall.ratesHint: One rate for the whole period, for balances and operations alike. The suggestion is the last rate known on the period’s end; you can change it.
waterfall.fxHintFixed: One rate covers the whole period, so no rate movement lands here. Only the difference from exchanges between your own accounts is left: their actual rate differs from the chosen one.
